svg.title: Mockup 10: The install kit
svg.text: 10 · The install kit: check the host, answer the wizard, then start fresh or restore (superadmin)
Use case: a fresh Debian VM, or the fallback laptop. U13, O6, O7, D3; builds on setup/install --boot (built).

svg.text: Signed in as the owner with the first-run code (#10).
Create the first event from the demo profile or from an event's profile zip. Readiness then shows
Bring back a platform from its off-VM backups. It runs in a terminal, because the platform may be
down when you need it: setup/restore with the emergency kit.
Afterwards: Health → Platform shows backups, the watchdog and the release (mockup 04).

The same kit installs the fallback laptop (setup/install --wizard --laptop): no public domain, the warm copy on, and setup/fallback check posting its result to the platform (U10). The wizard writes only deploy/.env; real values never enter the repo.
